check: All MCC DAQ specifications confirmed in official datasheets
how_to_verify: Compare channel counts, sample rates, isolation, power and counters against MCC datasheets

check: Each DAQ is powered correctly (USB or external 5 V as required)
how_to_verify: Plug in each DAQ and confirm it enumerates in InstaCal

check: Each DAQ has a unique serial number and board number recorded
how_to_verify: Record in InstaCal and in the channel config

check: LabVIEW version is supported by ULx (2022 to 2025) and installed after InstaCal
how_to_verify: Open the ULx palette and run the example VI for each DAQ

check: Windows power saving and USB selective suspend are disabled
how_to_verify: Check power plan and device manager, run an overnight idle test

check: Each sensor type has been bench tested into its channel before field install
how_to_verify: Simulate each signal (decade box, 4-20 mA calibrator, thermocouple simulator) and compare to the display

check: 4-20 mA loops tested at 4 mA and 20 mA
how_to_verify: Use a loop calibrator across the shunt and check 1 V and 5 V

check: String pot excitation is stable and below 30 V
how_to_verify: Measure the excitation with a meter and on the monitor channel

check: Shields grounded at one end and no ground loops
how_to_verify: Measure noise with sensors connected and motors off, then on

check: Power meters respond over RS-485 at the configured addresses
how_to_verify: Poll each address from a Modbus test tool before LabVIEW

check: Status inputs match the real control signals
how_to_verify: Operate each jack with the sensors connected and compare to the logged state

check: Load cells calibrated and zeroed
how_to_verify: Apply known loads, record offsets and scale factors in the config

check: String pots calibrated over travel
how_to_verify: Compare against a tape measure at several heights

check: Thermocouples verified
how_to_verify: Check in an ice bath and against the Fluke 62 MAX

check: Current channels verified
how_to_verify: Compare against the Extech MA63 at several loads

check: Channel config file loads and scales all channels correctly
how_to_verify: Compare logged values against the manual readings

check: Logging and cycle detection run for at least one hour without gaps
how_to_verify: Review TDMS for missing samples

check: Fast and slow streams share a common time marker
how_to_verify: Check the motor start event in both streams

check: Enclosure is sealed and temperature rise is acceptable
how_to_verify: Check temperature inside the enclosure after a long run

check: Monitoring only. No safety function depends on this system.
how_to_verify: Document and sign off

check: Pre-configured laptop boots, recognizes all DAQs by serial number and starts logging with one action
how_to_verify: Cold start test after disconnecting and reconnecting all USB devices

check: Cabling is labeled and terminated at connectors or terminal blocks so field connection takes a defined time
how_to_verify: Time a full connection procedure and write it down
